chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding a slap whose mark turns black on the face that its compensation is six dinars. If it does not turn black but turns green, then its compensation is three dinars. If it turns red and does not turn green, then its compensation is one dinar and a half.
He said: As for injuries of the body, then in them there is qisas, unless the wounded person accepts the blood-money compensation for the injury, in which case it is given to him.

key_terms.أَرْشَهَا: its assessed monetary compensation for injury
key_terms.اللَّطْمَةِ: a slap or blow to the face
key_terms.دَنَانِيرَ: gold dinars used as the compensation amount

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on compensation for a slap mark or bodily injury in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith sets legal compensation amounts for a slap to the face according to the severity and color of the visible mark. It also states that bodily wounds are subject to qisas, unless the injured party agrees to accept financial compensation instead.
